name: Mystery Snack Agent
description: Orders a dessert for Friday at 7pm and refuses to say what it is until the delivery arrives. Setup covers your preferences, allergies, payment card and delivery app; the surprise is the point, so it is a poor fit for anyone who wants to approve the order.

official.title: Mystery Snack Agent by Nayli
official.description: A Friday 7pm dessert, delivered as a surprise. Sets your taste, allergies, card, and app first. Keeps the pick secret until it arrives.
